notes.title: An Exceptionally Minor Update
notes.content:
Thanks to all who are continuing to provide feedback and data by continuing to playtest the game.

We've made quite a few changes to equipment, including adding the 20th (and last) bit of equipment. For those of you playing on the Demo, this also means you'll have a different selection of equipment to use; some have been rotated out, and some have been rotated in.

[list]
[*] Compendium tabs now must be unlocked by scanning for each ship
[*] Added stats
[*] Added basic quests to the compendium, unlocking additional compendium entries
[*] Fixed a bug where freeze equipment froze the game
[*] Fixed a crash related to dying in the hub world
[*] Freeze equipment now can be held to gradually bring ships and projectiles to full speed
[*] Added grapple equipment: latch on to loot, or grab an enemy and use your momentum for massive collision damage
[*] Dash no longer dashes, has been renamed to Roll
[*] Roll equipment now includes additional stunts to preserve combo, which can be performed by holding down the action button
[*] Roll equipment now flashes when invulnerable, same as all other actions
[*] Ram no longer deals damage, has been renamed to Burst
[*] Removed the windup from Burst
[*] Burst can now be canceled by releasing the action button
[*] Rain equipment does more damage
[*] Rain equipment now breaks apart at a fixed distance, increased by holding down the effect
[*] Probe equipment now produces higher bigger probe explosions when upgraded
[*] Fixed a bug where slick would stick around even after respawning
[*] Added an option for shooting immediately when reloading
[*] Added sound effects for dying and round end
[*] Added sound effects for gaining and building combos
[*] Updated the compendium to be compatible with the new UI system
[*] Fixed a bug where animations would skip a few frames
[/list]

For a full list of recent changes, see the Little Blue [url=discord.gg/msE8f87DT6]discord[/url].

notes.title: Update 3-10-2025
notes.content:
Thanks to all who participated in the Next Fest Demo!
As a result of this event, we've gotten a great deal of feedback and data which will help bring Little Blue to be complete in due time.
This update applies to both the Demo and Test builds of the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash related to some controller configurations
[*] Fixed a bug where some sounds were played at a lower quality than intended
[/list]

Numerous minor updates have been released since the demo's launch, not all of which are labeled. Here are some of the highlights:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash related to players dying on the same frame
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes players couldn't select their own upgrades
[*] Upgraded laser now fires multiple lasers
[*] Can now queue multiple rams in a row
[*] Boss no longer pushes your ship during phases 2 and 3
[*] Boss can now take damage while firing its laser, allowing it to be interrupted
[/list]

For a full list of recent changes, see the [url=discord.gg/msE8f87DT6]Little Blue discord[/url].
